key.name: home-workspace-index
key.description: The reserved workspace, counted from zero. It never receives a fullscreen window, and windows return here when they are minimized or un-maximized.

key.name: force-fullscreen
key.description: Put the window into true fullscreen after moving it to its own workspace, hiding the top bar. When disabled the window is left merely maximized on its own workspace.

key.name: return-on-minimize
key.description: Move a managed window back to the home workspace when it is minimized, and follow it there.

key.name: return-on-unmaximize
key.description: Move a managed window back to the home workspace when it is un-maximized or leaves fullscreen, and follow it there.

key.name: startup-delay-ms
key.description: Grace period after the extension is enabled before any window is moved, so that windows restored at login are not reshuffled.
